Container.Name: BookVault
Container.Overview: Self-hosted household book catalog with normalized works, editions and copies, per-person reading, circulation, backups, imports and embedded SQLite.

Config.Name: Application Port
Config.Description: Internal BookVault listening port; keep this set to 8130

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite database and persistent application data

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID; owns files under /config

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Unraid users group ID; owns files under /config

Config.Name: Google Books API key
Config.Description: Optional server-side Google Books API key; Open Library is used when Google is unavailable

Config.Name: Hardcover API token
Config.Description: Optional private server-side Hardcover token for more cover choices and authoritative series imports

Config.Name: Trust reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set true only when Book Vault is behind a trusted HTTPS reverse proxy that forwards the original protocol and host

Config.Name: Public origin
Config.Description: Optional exact external origin behind a proxy, for example https://books.example.com (no trailing path)

Config.Name: Admin name
Config.Description: Initial administrator display name (first run only)

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Required on first run. Enter a unique 12–128 character administrator password; no production password is supplied.
